In the online A/B test, GenRec showed an average treatment effect of **+0.115%** on the short-term homepage engagement metric compared with the production model, with **P = 3.1 × 10⁻¹⁰**. Figure 3 marks this as statistically significant (page 6).

The test used about 10% of Netflix traffic for 4 weeks. GenRec was run in a low-data, low-signals configuration (page 6).

For comparison, the long-term core metric improved by +0.006% with P = 0.025, also significant (page 6).
